name: DNA Repair Defect Other Than Combined T-cell and B-cell Immunodeficiencies

criteria.description: Presence of clinical features consistent with DNA repair deficiency such as growth retardation, microcephaly, or developmental delay
Abnormal cellular DNA repair capacity demonstrated by functional assays (e.g., increased chromosomal breakage or hypersensitivity to DNA damaging agents)
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes involved in DNA repair pathways excluding those causing combined T-cell and B-cell immunodeficiencies
Exclusion of combined T-cell and B-cell immunodeficiencies by immunophenotyping and functional immune assays

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All three major criteria (clinical features, abnormal DNA repair assay, and pathogenic genetic variant) must be met with exclusion of combined immunodeficiencies.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires multidisciplinary evaluation including clinical, laboratory, and genetic testing.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Chromosomal instability with spontaneous chromosomal breakage

common.symptomName: Growth retardation with failure to thrive
Developmental delay including motor and cognitive impairment

searchTerms: slight anemia or low blood counts

occasional.symptomName: Ocular abnormalities including cataracts or retinal degeneration
searchTerms: cloudy eye lens or retina damage

occasional.symptomName: Mild skeletal abnormalities such as short stature or clinodactyly

rare.symptomName: Malignancies such as lymphoma or leukemia in childhood

searchTerms: worsening brain function with balance problems
hormone problems including low thyroid function

rare.symptomName: Pulmonary fibrosis or chronic lung disease
searchTerms: lung scarring or chronic lung disease

laboratory: Increased chromosomal breakage on cytogenetic testing
Hypersensitivity to DNA damaging agents in cell culture
imaging: Brain MRI showing microcephaly and possible white matter abnormalities
Skeletal X-rays showing mild bone abnormalities
genetic: Pathogenic variants in DNA repair genes excluding those causing combined immunodeficiencies (e.g., NBN, ERCC genes)
Negative for mutations causing combined T-cell and B-cell immunodeficiencies
other: Abnormal cellular response to ionizing radiation
Normal or mildly reduced immunoglobulin levels without combined immunodeficiency

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of combined T-cell and B-cell immunodeficiency
Characteristic telangiectasia and progressive cerebellar ataxia
Congenital malformations including radial ray defects
Progressive bone marrow failure and pancytopenia

redFlags: Severe chromosomal instability on cytogenetic testing
Early onset microcephaly with developmental delay
Hypersensitivity to ionizing radiation or DNA damaging agents
references: Schultz RA, et al. DNA repair defects and human disease. Annu Rev Genomics Hum Genet. 2020.
Orphanet: DNA repair defect other than combined T-cell and B-cell immunodeficiencies (ORPHA:169346).
Kraemer KH, et al. DNA repair and human disease: lessons from xeroderma pigmentosum. Nat Rev Genet. 2021.
